additional_info.subject: RE: ID0373842-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002202] error Code 67 CRM:01811000219
additional_info.body:
Hello
Milan Klempay﻿,
I hope you're doing well. I wanted to provide you with information regarding the error.
The description of error code 67 indicates that the EV stops charging in an emergency shutdown manner.
One possible cause for this issue is that the EV decided to terminate the charging session prematurely due to Vehicle-to-Grid(V2G) communication.
This error cannot be resolved in the upcoming firmware version 5.0x.
If you have any further questions please feel free to reach out.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita Khobare
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
